scope: One P5A commit and one push to origin/desktop/p2-production-integration; no subsequent push authorized
sensitive_pattern_scan: No private-key blocks, GitHub token patterns or AWS access-key ID patterns in new CI/workflow files
file_review: Only workflow, CI helper/tests/docs/synthetic evidence, import-order-only existing test cleanup, P4 optional output path and file-handle fix, and CI output ignore rule
junit_hostnames: Sanitized before staging; raw local reports kept outside repository
production_credentials: No secrets referenced or signing credentials consumed
upload_policy: Only audited unsigned package/checksum/build metadata and synthetic diagnostics; no release/publication/deployment steps
artifact_upload_safety: Workflow path and content gates reviewed. Actual future hosted artifact still requires successful audit before upload; no future bytes or checksum are inferred.
log_normalization: Trimmed trailing whitespace only; raw copy retained outside repository
